_note: The 2026-2027 lineup grows through the year as sponsors sign. Add a sponsor to its tier, or copy a tier to add a new one. A sponsor with "logo": null shows its name until the file arrives. Tiers render in the order listed.
_moreToAnnounce: true shows 'more partners will be announced soon' under the tiers. Set it to false once the lineup is final — a permanent 'more coming' on a finished list reads as neglect.
_layout_rules: Static tiered grid — NO carousel. Higher tiers get larger logo cells. All logos in uniform cream/white cards with consistent padding so mismatched logo shapes read as intentional. Links open in a new tab with rel=noopener.
_filename_rules: Rename every logo file to sponsor-<name>.svg (preferred — a real vector from the sponsor's brand kit) or sponsor-<name>.png (transparent background, full colour, 1000px+ wide). The old Wix site shipped assets literally named 'Screenshot 2025-05-18 at 7.27.48 PM.png' — none of those filenames survive the migration.

body.fr: Nos commanditaires permettent aux étudiants de JMSB de compétitionner sur la scène mondiale.
